newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's Banco Provincial mulls ADRs.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's Banco Provincial mulls ADRs.

text.p: Leading Venezuelan bank Banco Provincial is mulling the possibility of an American Depository Receipts issue once Venezuelan authorities approve its application to become a universal bank, the bank said.
"We hope the Banking Superintendency will approve our application this month. Once that's done, we'll consider the possibility of an ADR issue," bank President Jose Maria Nogueroles said.
The issue would follow on the heels of Venezuelan banks Mercantil and Venezolano de Credito, which offered Level One ADR issues in August.

Banco Provincial is Venezuela's largest bank. According to Softline Consultants, at the end of September total deposits stood at 950 billion bolivars ($2 billion), total assets 1.2 trillion bolivars ($2.6 billion), and loans 375 billion bolivars ($800 million).
